changes.finding: Community Housing Fund: passes the eligibility items this screen checks: unit mix matches 30/50/20 within tolerance; site control (council resolution) meets the readiness bar; construction must be able to start within 18 months of award. Not assessed here: need and demand, the operator's capacity, the fund's rated criteria and the budget. Its 2025 call did not proceed (February 2026), so no intake is open now; the program page says it will post when next seeking proposals (as of 22 Sep 2026).
Not for this option: the program is for a shelter, and the option is independent rental.
Not for this option: the program is for a shelter or transitional housing, and the option is independent rental.

Would be a program for this housing if it is Indigenous-led, or partnered with an Indigenous housing provider or Nation (not said on the option): affordable rental homes for Indigenous families, Elders, individuals and people with disabilities, on and off reserve; every home rent geared to income (fixed rents may be considered on reserve). It funds building the homes (the Province's funding programs page: "funding to build and to support the creation of" them). A project enters by BC Housing's request for proposals. No intake is open now (closed: no call is posted on the program page (read 23 Nov 2026)). Its homes are all rent geared to income; this option has 33 market-rent homes, which it would not carry. Its criteria are not tested here.
Not for this option: this standard is for a shelter's sleeping rooms, and the option is independent rental.
FSR 5.09 (10,857 m² over 2,134.4 m², the site area the by-law fixes for its FSR) is within the outright maximum of 6.9.
Height 45.75 m is within the outright maximum of 51.0 m.
35 of 85 units (41.2%) have two or more bedrooms, against a 25.0% minimum; the 25 supportive homes are left out of the count, as the plan allows (35 of all 110 is 31.8%).
No minimum off-street parking applies citywide since June 2024; the option provides 40 vehicle and 208 bicycle spaces. Bicycle spaces are set by the Parking By-law at the development permit stage.
Meets the City's social housing definition: 70.0% of units for households below HILs (minimum 30.0%), owned by a province, secured for 99 years.
